title: feat: part grouping
body:
<!-- Please provide the issue number here if any -->

> Fixes #

## Changelog Entry

- Added visual message grouping following the `isPartOf` property of the `Message` entity, in PR [#5553](https://github.com/microsoft/BotFramework-WebChat/pull/5553), by [@OEvgeny](https://github.com/OEvgeny)
   - The mode is suitable for providing chain-of-thought reasoning
   - Added visual indication of `creativeWorkStatus` property in `Message` entity:
      - `undefined` - no indicator is shown
      - `'incomplete'` - show loader aside from the message
      - `'published'` - show checkmark aside from the message
   - Added a `position` property support for the `Message` entity
      - The `position` property takes precedence over existing sequence id

## Description

This PR introduces a **Part Grouping** feature that allows activities to be logically grouped and displayed in a collapsible format based on the information provided by activity `Message` entities. The implementation provides an AI-friendly way to organize related activities (like multi-step reasoning, code generation, or analysis workflows) into cohesive, user-manageable groups.

## Design

Enter logical grouping: the concept allowing Web Chat to dynamically decide to group activities while maintaining proper focus management and ordering.

The decision to show the activity in the group is shifted to the group view logic. The logic is responsible for calling a hook which makes the group available up in the tree for managing focus.

The message order is handled by the existing reducer logic which now tracks the `position` field from the `Message` entity but only in case when the message is a part of any group (`isPartOf.@id` field is specified).

The work started to replace the activity decorator component in the `fluent-theme` package with the new `PartGroupingDecorator`. The idea is the later should be more generic and should allow for more versatile style. The PR includes the preview of this change and further work is needed to cleanup and improve the approach.

Focus management got major overhaul with logical grouping support. This mostly is based on the previous approach with added complexity of managing groups state and order.

## Specific Changes

- **createActivitiesReducer.ts**: added activity ordering with entity position support
- **ActivityLogicalGrouping***: added new context provider for managing logical activity groupings
- **TranscriptFocus***: reworked focus logic with group-aware navigation
- **CollapsibleContent.tsx**: added core collapsible content component with accessibility features
- **PartGrouping***: added part grouping middleware implementation
- **PartGroupingDecorator.tsx**: added fluent UI styling for grouped activities
